sections.title: Contributors to population change in Ryedale
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Ryedale, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 2,750 people (−5.0%). In total, there were 4,117 births and 6,867 deaths in Ryedale between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 6,538 (11.8%). There were 35,703 people entering the area and 29,165 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in Ryedale of 159 people (−0.3%), as a result of 1,144 people entering the area and 1,303 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Ryedale's population of 558 (1.0%).as a result of 2,060 people entering the area and 1,502 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
